title: Pilot photo of ARV over Provo

tellings.quote: He has an image taken by a pilot Harvey something I can't quite remember over Provo Utah right by Dougway proving grounds in the 60s

plain: A researcher who goes by the name UAPGerb says that an artist, Mark McCandlish, has a photo taken in the 1960s by a pilot whose first name was Harvey. According to UAPGerb, the photo was taken over Provo, Utah, near Dugway Proving Ground, a military testing site, and it shows an ARV, short for "alien reproduction vehicle", a craft said to be built by humans copying alien technology. If true, it would suggest such craft were flying over Utah decades ago.
